[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.2.0.13

[*] Camera not longer can be moved behind the pause or settings screen

[/list]

notes.title: v2.0.2.5 patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
 [*] Scenario 7 for campaign mode
 [*] Allow free camera rotation with ctrl-WASD
 [*] Allow upgrading roads to level 2, 3
 [*] Added temple building which generates more mana the higher it is
 [*] Added mill building that increases the output of resource buildings around it
 [*] Fix bug with only first currency in unkeep actually being charged for level 3+ buildings
 [*] Change efficiency calculations so base production stays the same but efficiency increases from building levels
 [*] Roads become less efficient if upkeep resources are not present
 [*] Fixed bug in sentry crash analytics
 [*] Prevented temperature variance from being changed in scenarios
 [*] Disable building upgrade button if building can't be upgraded
 [*] Changed mana generation to slow down increase as population grows
 [*] Fixed crash when adding water whilst zoomed in
[/list]
